# Third-party browser assets

The following upstream browser packages are stored locally so production pages do not depend on an unpinned CDN response.

| Package | Version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nunito (Latin webfont subset) | Variable 400-900 | SIL OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito |
| Waline client | 3.15.2 | MIT | https://github.com/walinejs/waline |
| Live2D Widgets | 1.0.1 | GPL-3.0 | https://github.com/stevenjoezhang/live2d-widget |

License texts are retained at `../fonts/OFL.txt`, `waline/LICENSE`, and `live2d/LICENSE`. Model data and the optional Cubism 5 runtime are still obtained from their configured upstream providers when those features are used.
